## Synopsis

Runs the Straza background service. It alone holds each enrolled user's key and
every Straza session on this machine, and the hooks, straza mcp and the other
commands reach it over a local socket, a named pipe on Windows, where the system
names the caller.

On Linux it runs in the foreground, and a Linux package runs it under its own
account. The Straza package for macOS runs it under its own account as the
launchd daemon ai.straza.service. With STRAZA_HOME set, on Linux or macOS, it
runs as you for that home, with its socket and state inside it.

On Windows it runs only as the Windows service straza-service, which the Service
Control Manager starts, and it refuses to start from a console.

```
straza service [flags]
```
